methodology.avoidable_escalation_primary_denominator: all_escalated_tickets (n=486, since 0 escalated tickets have blank eng_outcome); closed_escalated (n=452) also reported
methodology.reopen_rate_denominators: reopen_rate_all_pct uses all tickets (n=1444); reopen_rate_closed_pct uses closed tickets (n=1396); both reported
methodology.true_fcr_definition: status == 'Closed' AND escalated_to_eng == 'No' AND reopen_count == 0; primary denominator = closed tickets (n=1396), secondary = all tickets (n=1444)

resolution_hours_definition.first_response_hours: (first_response_at - created_at) in hours on non-blank first_response_at (n=1439)
resolution_hours_definition.first_close_hours: (first_closed_at - created_at) in hours on non-blank first_closed_at (n=1402) and closed-only (n=1396)
resolution_hours_definition.final_close_hours: (final_closed_at - created_at) in hours on closed tickets (n=1396)
resolution_hours_definition.open_age_hours: (2026-09-30 23:59:59 - created_at) in hours on open tickets (n=48)

methodology.eom_open_backlog_definition: tickets with created_at <= month_end 23:59:59 AND (final_closed_at is blank OR final_closed_at > month_end 23:59:59)
